success_criteria: Blind tasting: at least one loaf is judged closer to the requested sourness — target sourness ≈0.90 on the 0-1 scale (more sour than the sourest judged loaf (0.75)); the same feedback parser scores the new comments.
Crumb: judged crumb openness ≥0.67 (keep crumb as open as Loaf A (0.72)); crumb photo shows no collapse or gumminess.
Proofing: each chamber ends at its rise plateau — starter height must not fall >3% below its peak before ending (no overproofing).
Discrimination: the two loaves are distinguishable in blind tasting on the targeted attribute, so the two mechanisms can be told apart.
Model check: measured end-of-fermentation pH within ±0.15 of the simulated value.
